text.en:
For the operation and maintenance of the institution established in Welfareville under Act
Numbered Forty-two hundred and nine, there is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine
Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, the sum of twenty-one thousand pesos, to be spent as follows:
SALARIES AND WAGES
(With subsistence and quarters)
One physician
?2,400.00
One head nurse
960.00
Two nurses, at W20 per annum each
1,440.00
480.00
Temporary and emergency employees and laborers
3,200.00
-------------
Total for salaries and wages
8,480.00
SUNDRY EXPENSES
Postal, telegraph, telephone and cable service
120.00
Illumination and power service
1,400.00
Consumption of supplies and materials
9,100.00
Other services
1,800.00
Traveling expenses of persons not government employees

100.00
-------------
Total for sundry expenses
12,520.00
-------------
Grand total
?21,000.00

Any unexpended balance of this appropriation remaining on December thirty-first, nineteen
hundred and thirty-seven, shall revert to the unappropriated surplus in the Philippine Treasury.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-seven.
Approved, October 20, 1936.
